note: Measured starboard hull sections of the GameModels3D pasc006 viewing reference, measured with bun run ship:lines. Runtime z = reference z + 0.275; station = 82.275 - z, from the transom (0) to the stem (length). Points [half-breadth, height] run from the keel on the centreline to the deck edge. Measurement only: no reference mesh is stored. Merged per station from ship:lines passes capped with --deck-below 3.5-8.4 m in 2 cm steps (--breaks none, --span -82.55,82.0, --high 0.2,0.4,0.6,0.75,0.85,0.92,0.96,0.985,1): each station keeps the first cap at or above its weather deck at the side, probed 0.3-0.45 m inboard of the deck edge with ship:slice --probe (a probe over 0.12 m from its neighbours is replaced by the line through them), because deckhouses within 2 m of the side and deck plating cut across the centreline hide the deck from the lines walk. Between reference z -60 and 70 the deck-edge half-breadth is the running median of five stations, since the capped walk ends on the rounded gunwale.
